CREATE TABLE daily_plan_record (
	id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	symbol VARCHAR(9) NOT NULL, 
	lineage VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_record_revision CHECK (revision >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_record_kind CHECK (kind IN ('SIGNAL','RISK','FACT','REPORT','POSITION','EVALUATION','REVIEW','DRAFT','EXTRACTION','REASSESSMENT'))
)
